title: Agents cannot open PRs, and a hand-opened PR cannot merge through its thread.
whatHappens: the PR call fails with "Could not resolve to a Repository". Approval failed 4 times and checks failed 7 times on live with "no pull request".
fix: open PRs through the App route, and link an existing PR by head branch (proposed).
